title: Proper degree-two coordinates and compactification genus
statement: Let k contained in K be algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], f:C over k a smooth proper separated connected curve [def-sc-curves], c a smooth connected proper compactification with finite closed boundary [lem-sc-compactification], and n positive and nonzero in k. Let r be canonical constant-coefficient cohomology pullback and t,tK the cohomology equivalences of the primitive-root trivializations [def-sc-mu-trivialization]. Then f's genus equals c's genus [def-sc-genus]. There exist additive equivalences e:H2(C,Z/n) to Z/n and eK:H2(C_K,Z/n) to Z/n which satisfy eK(r(x))=e(x). For each line bundle over either curve, the inverse-trivialized Kummer boundary [lem-sc-kummer-les] is sent to its degree modulo n [def-pc-degree-line-bundle].

source.place: proof, proper case: Pic/n via degree and compactification equals the proper curve

proof.text: The compactification open immersion is proper because its composite is proper and the target is separated over the field. Its image is both open and closed and is nonempty, so connectedness of the compactification makes it surjective. It is an isomorphism over k; transport of relative differentials and global sections preserves genus.

Over both fields, Brauer vanishing and the Kummer sequence identify H2(mu_n) with Pic/n. Picard degree zero is n-divisible, and a rational point has degree one, so degree induces an additive equivalence from this quotient to Z/n. Compose it with the prescribed cohomological primitive-root trivialization to obtain e and eK. By construction their values on Kummer boundaries are line-bundle degrees modulo n.

The Picard Kummer boundary is surjective by Brauer vanishing. Evaluate eK(r(x)) and e(x) on this surjective image, use the constant-coefficient Kummer boundary naturality, and apply preservation of line-bundle degree under field extension. Equality on the image is equality on every class.

theorem IsConnectedCurve.constant_proper_degree_coordinates
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [Algebra k K]
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f]
    (c : Compactification f) [IsConnectedCurve c.g] [Smooth c.g]
    (_hfin : (Set.range c.i.base)ᶜ.Finite)
    (_hclosed : ∀ x ∈ (Set.range c.i.base)ᶜ, IsClosed ({x} : Set c.Z))
    (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (_hn : (n : k) ≠ 0)
    (r : ∀ q : ℕ, Sheaf.H (C.constantZMod n) q →+
        Sheaf.H ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).constantZMod n) q)
    (hr : (∀ q : ℕ, r q =
        (Sheaf.H.map (((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).app
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))).hom) q).comp
          (Etale.cohomologyMap
            (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
            (C.constantZMod n) q)))
    (ζ : k) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    (hζK : IsPrimitiveRoot (algebraMap k K ζ) n)
    (t : ∀ q : ℕ, Sheaf.H (C.constantZMod n) q ≃+
          Sheaf.H (C.rootsOfUnitySheaf n) q)
        (tK : ∀ q : ℕ,
          Sheaf.H ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).constantZMod n) q ≃+
          Sheaf.H
            ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).rootsOfUnitySheaf n) q)
    (ht : (∀ q : ℕ, (t q).toAddMonoidHom =
          Sheaf.H.map (C.constantZModIsoRootsOfUnitySheaf n f hζ).hom q))
    (htK : (∀ q : ℕ, (tK q).toAddMonoidHom = Sheaf.H.map
          ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k
            K)))).constantZModIsoRootsOfUnitySheaf n
              (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) hζK).hom q))
    [IsProper f] :
    f.genus = c.g.genus ∧
    ∃ (e : Sheaf.H (C.constantZMod n) 2 ≃+ ZMod n)
            (eK : Sheaf.H
              ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).constantZMod n) 2 ≃+
                ZMod n),
            (∀ x, eK (r 2 x) = e x) ∧
            (∀ (hnC : IsUnit (n : Γ(C, ⊤))) (L : Additive C.Pic),
              e ((t 2).symm (C.kummerδ₁ n hnC
                (Scheme.Pic.toCohomologicalPicardGroupAddEquiv C L))) =
                  (f.picDegree L.toMul : ZMod n)) ∧
            (∀ (hnK : IsUnit (n : Γ(pullback f
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))), ⊤)))
              (L : Additive (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).Pic),
              eK ((tK 2).symm
                ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).kummerδ₁ n hnK
                  (Scheme.Pic.toCohomologicalPicardGroupAddEquiv
                    (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) L))) =
                  ((pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).picDegree
                    L.toMul : ZMod n))
